bio: Festival photographer and stage-light chaser: crowds, lasers and the faces of a good set. Concert and club nights.
avatar: Portrait of a person in their mid 30s with short bleached hair and a camera strap, concert lights in purple and blue behind them, grinning, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person, clearly an adult
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a concert stage with sweeping coloured beams and a packed crowd silhouette at night, subject across the middle band, cinematic

collections.title: Lights & crowds
videos: Beach club afternoon, glitter and bass

videos.title: Concert, front barrier
videos.description: Beams, smoke and a roaring front row.
videos.still: Wide cinematic photograph of a live rock concert seen from the front barrier with a band in silhouette on stage, sweeping coloured beams, smoke and a roaring crowd of adults with raised hands, no readable faces, no text
videos.motion: Beams sweep across the stage, smoke rolls and the crowd surges and jumps with raised hands, camera rises over the barrier.

videos.title: Beach club afternoon, glitter and bass
videos.description: Sunlit pool, loungers and a DJ playing to the sand.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a sunny beach club with a pool, white loungers, adults in swimwear and party outfits dancing and a DJ booth, turquoise sea behind, tasteful, fictional adults clearly over 25, tasteful, energetic, cinematic, no text
videos.motion: People dance by the pool, water splashes, sunlight sparkles, camera glides along the pool edge.

videos.title: Wristband tan lines
videos.still: Vertical close-up photograph of a hand with neon festival wristbands and glitter on the skin, lights blurred in the background, no face, no text
videos.motion: Glitter sparkles as the hand waves, coloured lights pulse, subtle macro drift.

videos.title: Smoke machine, empty stage
videos.description: An empty stage before the doors open, a smoke machine and beams of light sweeping the haze.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of an empty concert stage with a smoke machine puffing and coloured beams sweeping the haze, no people, no text
videos.motion: Smoke billows and beams sweep through it, slow camera push-in.
